summary: Zod contracts for generation-scoped remote session state, desired/observed pane graphs, Pi chat commands/history, and revisioned mutations.
transport: Shared TypeScript contract definitions imported by the API and client packages; this file defines the JSON parameter/result shapes, while transport routing is handled separately.
version: State result envelope declares schemaVersion 5; revisions, hostGeneration and storeGeneration scope observed state and mutations.

messages.name: axo.state.get / workspace.list / session.list / session.get
messages.summary: Read generation/revision-enveloped desired workspace, session and observed pane data using bounded cursors.

messages.name: axo.state.chat.command.submit / command.get
messages.summary: Submit or read send/steer/cancel/answer commands bound to runtime, host, store and revision identities.

messages.name: axo.state.chat.history / tool.get
messages.summary: Cursor-based live/stopped history and bounded tool-output chunks with head-digest/runtime checks.

messages.name: axo.state.workspace.create / session.create / rename / lifecycle.set / pane.add / pane.remove / session.delete
messages.summary: Revisioned mutations carry command IDs and accepted graphs/receipts; layout and graph invariants constrain pane identities and workspace/session composition.

parsing.summary: Zod strict schemas reject unknown fields and enforce UUIDs, generations, revision order, graph membership, pane-role constraints, layout depth/node bounds, command payload sizes, and history cursor identity.

compatibility: The result envelope fixes schemaVersion 5. Host generation and store generation fence stale requests; revisions and commandId support conditional and reconcilable mutations.
